// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

#version 3.7;

#declare use_lightsys = 1;
#declare use_contrast = 1.6;
#declare use_photons  = on;

global_settings {

  assumed_gamma 1.0

  max_trace_level 5
  #if (use_photons)
    photons {
      spacing 0.02                 // specify the density of photons
      //count 100000               // alternatively use a total number of photons

      //gather min, max            // amount of photons gathered during render [20, 100]
      //media max_steps [,factor]  // media photons
      //jitter 1.0                 // jitter phor photon rays
      //max_trace_level 5          // optional separate max_trace_level
      //adc_bailout 1/255          // see global adc_bailout
      //save_file "filename"       // save photons to file
      //load_file "filename"       // load photons from file
      //autostop 0                 // photon autostop option
      //radius 10                  // manually specified search radius
      // (---Adaptive Search Radius---)
      //steps 1
      //expand_thresholds 0.2, 40
    }

  #end
}

// ground
plane { <0,1,0>, 0
    texture{ pigment{ color ReferenceRGB(<0.45,0.85,0.3>) * 0.42 }
    normal { bumps 0.75 scale 0.015}
    finish { phong 0.1}
  }
}

#declare Lightsys_Scene_Scale = 0.1;

// lamp
object {

    Lm_Incandescent_100w,
    x*0.45, z*0.45, 4, 4, off

}

  color ReferenceRGB(<1,0.94,0.5>) * 0.005

    sphere{ <0,0,0>, 0.75

        pigment{ color ReferenceRGB(<1,0.98,0.8>) * 1.6 }
        finish {
          ambient 0.8
          diffuse 0.7
          phong 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

#declare use_focal_blur = 0; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

camera {
  location < -40, 40, -40 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <784425, -196076, 588308>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(44.5605)/2)*image_width/image_height))

#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 5

  focal_point <0, 0, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)

}

#declare use_photons  = on;

global_settings {

  assumed_gamma 1.0

  max_trace_level 5
  #if (use_photons)
    photons {
      spacing 0.02                 // specify the density of photons
      //count 100000               // alternatively use a total number of photons

      //gather min, max            // amount of photons gathered during render [20, 100]
      //media max_steps [,factor]  // media photons
